calculate_edit_distance: calculate the edit distance between two strings using Levenshtein distance algorithm
test_edit_distance: test the edit_distance function with case_sensitive and case_insensitive comparisons
fuzzy_match_candidates: fuzzy match a query string against a list of candidates returning the first match index
fuzzy_match_with_threshold: fuzzy match candidates with a maximum edit distance threshold to find close matches
review_edit_distance: review the edit_distance function that computes minimum single-character edits between strings
